svg.aria-label: Pictogram of 140 wide-body aircraft on firm order, 80 Air India, 60 IndiGo. 72 of them are needed to hold Indian carriers' 45.9% share of the market at today's sector length. The remaining 68 are surplus to it, which is the reason this case exists.
svg.desc: Source: Airbus and Boeing order books and airport planning manuals; the capacity need is computed from DGCA. Pulled 2026-08-15.
